'''Goh's Aerodactyl''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのプテラ''' ''Go's Ptera'') is the thirty-first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] obtained in the [[Kanto]] [[region]], and his sixty-fifth overall.

==In animation==
===History===
===={{aniseries|JN}}====
[[File:JN038.png|thumb|left|250px|Aerodactyl and Goh]]
Aerodactyl debuted in ''[[JN038|Restore and Renew!]]'', during a visit that [[Goh]], {{Ash}}, and [[Chloe]] made to the [[Pewter Museum of Science]]. Goh was digging for [[Fossil]]s when he found a piece of [[Old Amber]], which he took to be revived by the [[Curator]]. Overnight, {{TRT}} broke into the Museum as Aerodactyl revived, causing it to go on a rampage. Alerted by the disturbance, Goh looked for Aerodactyl and found it and decided to catch it. Aerodactyl was able to defeat {{TP|Goh|Raboot}} before going up against his {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} and was defeated, allowing Goh to add Aerodactyl to his [[Party|team]].

In ''[[JN071|Leaping Toward the Dream!]]'', Goh used Aerodactyl to find an {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Ninetales}} as part of his quest for [[Project Mew]].

In ''[[JN090|Showdown at the Gates of Warp!]]'', Aerodactyl reverted into an {{pkmn|Egg}} as a result of a clash between {{OBP|Dialga|recurring}} and {{OBP|Palkia|recurring}} distorting time. After {{p|Arceus}} stopped the fight between Dialga and Palkia, the {{pkmn|category|Temporal and Spatial Pokémon}} repaired the distortions their fighting had caused and restored all the devolved Pokémon back to normal.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Aerodactyl attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

===Personality and characteristics===
As inherent to its species, Aerodactyl is initially seen as a very aggressive Pokémon that Goh only gains the confidence of after defeating it in battle. In its subsequent appearances, Aerodactyl is seen to be closely integrated with the rest of Goh's Pokémon. It is one of Goh's main Pokémon for aerial support, alongside {{TP|Goh|Flygon}}.
